start.title: NAHX Technologies – Understand Technology. Create Solutions.
start.description: Technical documentation, software development and automation: NAHX Technologies combines technical expertise with digital development to build clear solutions.
start.einleitung: I combine technical expertise with digital development – from technical documentation to custom software and intelligent automation.

abschnitte.text: Documentation, software and automation are intertwined in practice. That is why I offer them together, from one source.

karten.text: Make technical content clear, structured and verifiable: manuals, specifications, review workflows.
Custom web applications and internal tools that simplify specific tasks, from prototype to ongoing development.
Analyse recurring workflows and automate them where it makes sense, including AI support for information and document processes.

abschnitte.text: Every project is reviewed for confidentiality, rights and accurate attribution before publication. Only approved details appear here.
Good solutions start with understanding the problem. The process is an approach, not a guarantee; it adapts to scope and requirements.

schritte.text: Clarify the current situation, goals and challenges.
Define services, expected deliverables and constraints.
Develop and agree on a suitable approach.
Build in clear steps and keep decisions transparent.
Evaluate the result against agreed criteria and hand it over.

abschnitte.text: No metrics, no promises, just working principles that apply to every project.

punkte.text: You talk to the person who does the work. No intermediate layers.
Open issues and decisions are documented, not made silently.

punkte.h3: The right solution, not new software by default
punkte.text: Not every task needs a new tool. We first check what fits the actual need.
What is handed over has been checked against the agreed criteria, with sources and documentation.

abschnitte.text: Do you have a technical challenge, a manual process or an idea for a digital tool? I would be happy to learn about your requirements and discuss possible solutions.

leistungen.title: Services | NAHX Technologies
leistungen.description: Technical documentation, software and web applications, automation and AI: services by NAHX Technologies at the intersection of documentation and software.
leistungen.einleitung: I work at the intersection of technical documentation, software and digital processes. Depending on the requirements, the right solution may be a documentation service, a custom application or an improved workflow.

bereiche.text: Prepare technical content so that it is understandable, structured and verifiable. This covers new documents as well as revising existing material and the workflows behind it.
herausforderungen: Documents have grown over time; structure and terminology are inconsistent.
Review and approval steps are undefined or not traceable.
Content is scattered and maintained in several places.
leistungen: Creation and revision of technical content
faelle: A manual is restructured and its terminology unified.
A document review workflow is defined and backed by checklists.
Scattered content is moved into a reusable structure.
bereiche.fuer: Useful for technical companies, development teams and service providers that create, review or hand over documentation.

bereiche.text: Digital tools that simplify a specific task: from an internal helper to a web application with accounts and reports. Concept, implementation and ongoing development from one source.
herausforderungen: A process runs on spreadsheets, emails and shouting across the room, and is error-prone.
An idea should become tangible as a prototype before investing.
An existing application must be extended or connected to an interface.
leistungen: Development of web applications and internal tools
Data processing, interfaces and improvement of existing solutions
faelle: An internal tool replaces a spreadsheet and makes states traceable.
A prototype shows within weeks whether an approach holds.
A web application turns structured input into verifiable reports.
bereiche.fuer: Useful for teams with a clear need but no in-house development.

bereiche.text: Identify recurring work and automate it where it pays off. AI is used when it brings a traceable benefit, for example when evaluating documents, not as an end in itself.
herausforderungen: Recurring steps cost time and are done inconsistently.
Information is buried in documents and has to be extracted manually.
An AI approach should be tested without handing out data uncontrolled.
leistungen: Design and implementation of practical automation
faelle: A document review step is partly automated; the result stays traceable.
Incoming documents are pre-sorted and summarised; the decision stays with a person.
A local AI approach is tested where data does not leave the premises.
bereiche.fuer: Useful for organisations with recurring information and document tasks.

ueber-mich.title: About | NAHX Technologies
ueber-mich.description: About NAHX Technologies: technical services, development projects and digital solutions under one personal brand. Pragmatic, project-based and transparent work.
ueber-mich.h1: Understand Technology. See the Connections. Build Solutions.
ueber-mich.einleitung: I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.

absaetze: Behind NAHX Technologies is one person: I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.
With NAHX Technologies, I bring together my own technical services, development projects and future digital solutions under a personal brand. NAHX is a business name, not a company.

My approach is pragmatic: understand the requirements, develop an appropriate solution and validate the results transparently. I work directly and project by project, with the goal of translating technical complexity into practical outcomes.

abschnitte.text: How a project with me works, from the first conversation to the handover.

zusammenarbeit.title: How We Work | NAHX Technologies
zusammenarbeit.description: How a project with NAHX Technologies works: initial discussion, requirements and scope, implementation in clear steps, review and handover. Direct and clear.
zusammenarbeit.einleitung: Five steps from the first conversation to the handover. The process is a flexible approach, not a guarantee; it depends on the scope, complexity and requirements of each project.

schritte.text: We discuss the current situation, your goals and the challenges to be addressed.
We define the services needed, the expected deliverables and the relevant constraints.
I develop an approach, name alternatives and open issues, and we agree on the direction.
I work through the agreed scope in clear steps and keep important decisions transparent.
We evaluate the outcome against agreed criteria and coordinate the handover and any next steps.
